elements_selected.content: Implement the marks layer for DiamondCrdtDocument as decided in research/diamond-types-marks.md. Likely shape: a sibling diamond-types document keyed by mark-name carrying (start, end, scalar) intervals; updated atomically alongside text splices so positions stay consistent. Cover Peritext expand behavior per MarkType (Both for bold/italic/strikethrough/highlight; None for code/wikilink/link/comment). Reuse src/crdt/marks.rs MarkType verbatim — only its scalar_value/from_mark plumbing needs new internals. Property tests (proptest) for: (a) marks survive save/load, (b) inclusive marks grow at boundaries, (c) non-growing marks do not, (d) concurrent splices on different replicas converge with marks intact.
